{{Quote|He means one hundred, Colonel. Ten times ten. Or perhaps several hundred. We're still working on the concept of plurals. I think he indicates them with body twitches, but we're not there yet.|Unidentified Pop-Dog linguist to Stavin Thaal|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]], and served as a [[linguist]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> she was assigned to teach [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] to the unidentified species "Embassy-Who-Climbs", which had suddenly appeared on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] following some sort of fault-line slippage. The linguist taught the creature at least four hundred words and determined its role and mission. It sought to speak with the world's leader and was granted an audience with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], leader and founder of the Pop-Dogs, via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. After confirming that Thaal desired peace rather than war with its species, "Embassy-Who-Climbs" asked for its crystalline box filled with gems, which the linguist brought into the meeting room. "Embassy-Who-Climbs" then offered Thaal the box with the promise of more on the condition that they meet in person. When Thaal could not understand the unit of quantity used by the creature, the linguist stepped in and translated.<ref name="MK" />

Unbeknownst to the Pop-Dogs, Embassy-Who-Climbs was actually [[Turman Durra]], a member of the Galactic Alliance  [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], wearing a custom-grown [[Embass suit|suit]] while working [[Mission to Kuratooine|undercover]] to prove Thaal's criminal activities.<ref name="MK" />
